title: Exact boundary interval
prompt: Write exact_boundary(n,all_wins,alpha=.05), returning the Clopper-Pearson interval for zero wins or n wins. n is positive. Example: n=10,False gives (0,about .3085).
tests:
a=exact_boundary(10,False)
b=exact_boundary(10,True)
assert a[0]==0 and abs(a[1]-.3084971078)<1e-8, 'Zero of ten upper exact limit is about .3085'
assert b[1]==1 and abs(b[0]-.6915028922)<1e-8, 'Ten of ten lower exact limit is about .6915'
assert exact_boundary(20,False)[1]<a[1], 'More zero-win games tighten the upper bound'
hint: Solve the probability of all losses or all wins.

title: Apply a frozen threshold
prompt: Use supplied wilson and write passes(w,n,bar=.327). Return True only when an interval exists and its lower bound is strictly greater than bar. Example: no games fails.
tests:
assert passes(80,100), '80/100 has a lower bound above .327'
assert not passes(1,2), 'A point estimate above .327 alone is insufficient'
assert not passes(0,0), 'Missing evidence cannot pass'
assert not passes(5,10,wilson(5,10)[0]), 'The threshold comparison is strict'
